vector_set: Canonical NDC v2 Profile 1 — one authoritative contract version
note: All values are abstract strings. This vector records shape and strictness outcomes only.

cases.rule: contract_version appears exactly once, at the manifest root.
The nested duplicate schema_versions.contract_version is removed from the canonical schema; a release carrying it fails strict validation.
A second authority that can disagree is rejected even when its value happens to match.
Strict parsing rejects repeated property names before schema validation.
An unregistered contract version fails closed; no silent reinterpretation is applied.

cases.condition: the D1 requirements document retains a nested contract_version in its historical bytes
cases.rule: The change is carried as a separate formal requirements amendment; no approved D1 or D2 byte is edited or re-digested.
